articles.title: Juice Spacecraft Uses Earth as a Slingshot Toward Jupiter
articles.summary: ESA's Juice spacecraft swung past Earth on September 28, using gravity to speed up and change course toward Jupiter.

articles.title: Oklahoma's Buried Meteor Crater Is 100 Million Years Younger Than Thought
articles.summary: Tiny crystals show a meteor crater under Oklahoma formed about 370 million years ago, much later than scientists thought.

articles.title: A Forgotten Forest Experiment Grew Giant Trees
articles.summary: A 30-year Australian experiment found that thinned mountain ash forests grew huge trees and stored as much carbon as untouched forest.
